hints.title: Single Value Path Definition
hints.text: A path of identical values can extend downwards through either the left child or the right child, or unite both at a common ancestor.

hints.title: Post-Order Return Values
hints.text: For each node, compute the longest univalue arm extending into its left subtree and into its right subtree.

hints.title: Update Global Maximum
hints.text: If a child has the same value as the current node, extend the corresponding arm length by one; otherwise reset it to zero. Update the global max with left_arm plus right_arm, and return the maximum of the two arms to the parent.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Bottom-up post-order traversal tracking univalue branch extensions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing paths top-down causes quadratic O(N^2) visits for balanced trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Post-order recursion returns single arm extensions while updating diameter in O(H) stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinguish between the path through the node (sum of arms) and the value returned to parent (max of arms).
